title: Prisma Phase 2/3: Kissinger migration script + dual-write
description:
Database is now live (Neon via Vercel integration, eloso-bisque-prod, migration 20260721194352_init applied — all 16+ models created and confirmed reachable from production).

Remaining per docs/prisma-schema-design.md section 4.1:

Phase 2: One-time Node.js script to backfill all existing Kissinger GraphQL entities into the new Postgres schema (Contact, Organization, RelationshipFrom, OutreachQueueEntry, GeneratedMessage, Signal, ContactEvent, etc. per the mapping table in docs/prisma-schema-design.md section 4.2). Nothing has been migrated from Kissinger yet — the new DB currently has empty tables.

Phase 3: Dual-write period. Mutation API routes need to write to both Kissinger (back-compat) and Postgres. Read paths migrate in this order:
1. Activity Dashboard -> ActivityLog queries (simplest, do first)
2. Outreach queue -> OutreachQueueEntry + OutreachTouch
3. Contacts listing
4. Sectors heatmap (with Contacts listing)
5. Investors section
6. Contact detail / Funnel Kanban (last, needs relationship data fully populated)

Phase 4 (later): cut over, decommission Kissinger once dual-write is stable 2+ weeks.

No code for phases 2-4 has been written yet — this is scoping/tracking only.
notes:
[2026-07-22] Phase 3.1 (GH #42, Activity Dashboard dual-write + read cutover) implemented, tested, and deployed to prod. PR: https://github.com/eloso-bisque/eloso-bisque/pull/47

- Dual-write live in src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts and src/app/api/contacts/[id]/outreach-touch/route.ts (ActivityLog rows alongside untouched KV writes).
- src/lib/prisma.ts fixed (Prisma 7 needs an explicit driver adapter - was previously unused/unbuilt).
- Historical KV data seeded into ActivityLog and read-path cutover deployed to https://eloso-bisque-virid.vercel.app/admin/activity.
- Parity verified against real prod data: 42/42 rows matched (all 3 users, daily + last_login + all-time outreach totals).
- Issue #41 (Kissinger backfill, seeds the 3 User rows) landed mid-session, unblocking real verification instead of synthetic fixtures.
- Known gap: no real browser login test (no test credentials for drew/ben/jake) - flagged in the PR for a human to spot-check post-merge.

Not closing this bd issue - Phase 3.2-3.6 (Outreach queue, Contacts listing, Sectors heatmap, Investors, Contact detail/Funnel Kanban) remain, tracked as GH #43-#46.

comments.author: Lobster
comments.text:
Implementation plan (orchestrated via functional-engineer subagents, one GitHub issue per phase, sequential due to shared dual-write infra dependencies):

1. GH #41 - Backfill script (Phase 2): one-time Node/TS script, Kissinger GraphQL -> Postgres, idempotent/upsert on kissingerId, seeds 3 Users.
2. GH #42 - Dual-write infra (Prisma client) + Activity Dashboard read migration (Phase 3.1).
3. GH #43 - Outreach queue dual-write + read migration (Phase 3.2).
4. GH #44 - Contacts listing + Sectors heatmap read migration (Phase 3.3/3.4).
5. GH #45 - Investors section read migration (Phase 3.5).
6. GH #46 - Contact detail / Funnel Kanban read migration (Phase 3.6, last).

Phase 4 (Kissinger decommission) explicitly NOT in this pass - requires 2+ weeks of stable dual-write observation per bd issue description. Will recommend a dated follow-up.

Each issue goes through functional-engineer (Opus): branch + Docker dev + TDD + PR, with manual proof-of-work required. After each PR merges, deploying via vercel --prod and verifying prod before starting the next phase (phases build on shared dual-write code, so sequenced not parallelized).
